### Observed differences

- In the later window, the choice after A37 shifted toward A38: about 54 in 100 of A37's outgoing transitions lead to A38 (about 46 in 100 in the earlier window), while transitions to A39 fell from about 54 to about 46 in 100. A37 itself still occurs in every trace with an essentially unchanged profile. In line with this, A38 appears in about 69 in 100 traces (about 60 before) and repeats somewhat more often (in about 17 vs 11 in 100 of traces), while A39 and A40 each appear in about 59 in 100 traces (about 69 before). [DIR025, OCC024, OCC025, OCC026, OCC027]
- A17 and A18 moved in opposite directions: A17 appears in about 54 in 100 traces in the later window (about 44 before) and A18 in about 47 in 100 (about 57 before), with A19 slightly down (about 47 vs 51) and A20 slightly up (about 54 vs 50). The successions around them redistributed: A17 now leads to A26 in about 53 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (about 44 before) and to A19 in about 18 (about 32); A20 now leads to A17 in about 28 in 100 (about 17 before) and to A18 in about 21 (about 31); A19 now leads to A17 in about 29 in 100 (about 21 before) and to A26 in about 43 (about 53). [OCC014, OCC015, OCC016, OCC017, DIR010, DIR012, DIR013]
- The route from A26 through A30 and A31 is taken more often, and the route through A32 and A33 less often: A30 and A31 each appear in about 54 in 100 traces (about 46 before) and A32 and A33 each in about 46 in 100 (about 55 before); A26 now sends about 27 in 100 of its outgoing transitions to A30 (about 19 before), about 23 to A32 (about 28) and about 24 to A33 (about 27); the succession splits from A30 to A27/A31 and from A31 to A30/A27 evened from roughly 58/42 to 50/50. [OCC018, OCC019, OCC020, OCC021, DIR016, DIR019, DIR020]
- Within the group A01, A03, A04, A05 — each still present in about half of the traces in both windows — immediate successions shifted toward the chain A01→A03→A04→A05 and exit to A09: A01→A03 rose from about 28 to 47 in 100, A03→A04 from about 27 to 46, A04→A05 from about 27 to 40 and A05→A09 from about 29 to 39, while A04→A03 fell from about 39 to 20, A05→A04 from about 38 to 28, and the exits A01→A04, A01→A05 and A03→A09 (about 37 to 21) lost share. [DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- Smaller differences: A10 and A11 still occur in every trace but repeat in fewer of them (about 35 vs 43 in 100); A34 occurs and recurs slightly less often; A08 sends relatively more to A07 (about 41 vs 32 in 100); the remaining items show participation or routing differences of only about 1–5 in 100 with low empirical strength. [OCC009, OCC010, OCC022, DIR008, OCC002, OCC011, OCC012, OCC013, DIR023]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, the two existing alternative paths after A37 are taken with different frequencies: A37 leads to A38 in about 54 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (about 46 before) and to A39 in about 46 (about 54 before), so A38 appears in about 69 in 100 traces (up from about 60) while A39 and A40 each appear in about 59 in 100 (down from about 69). Supporting signs: the routing change is observed directly at the routing point A37, the participation of A38, A39 and A40 moved in mirror image and matching size (roughly 18–19 traces in 200 on each side), and every activity involved was observed in a substantial share of traces in both windows with only the shares between the alternatives shifting. Limitations: A38 also repeats in more traces than before (about 17 vs 11 in 100), a secondary change this path-frequency hypothesis does not cover, and with 200 traces per window and no stated chance expectation for the screening, an unusually large sampling fluctuation cannot be completely excluded. [DIR025, OCC024, OCC025, OCC026, OCC027]

Other differences:

- A17 gained about 10 in 100 traces while A18 lost about 10 in 100, and the surrounding successions (A17→A26 up, A17→A19 down, A20→A17 up, A20→A18 down, A19→A17 up, A19→A26 down) redistributed in the same direction, consistent with more flow passing through A17 and exiting via A26; the evidence contains no positional items, so a precise re-arrangement such as a swap versus a reroute cannot be confirmed. [OCC014, OCC015, DIR010, DIR012, DIR013]
- The path A26→A30/A31 is taken more often and A26→A32/A33 less often, with the succession splits from A30 and A31 towards A27 evening out to about 50/50. [OCC018, OCC019, OCC020, OCC021, DIR016, DIR019, DIR020]
- In the A01/A03/A04/A05 group the mix of execution orders shifted toward the sequence A01→A03→A04→A05→A09, while each activity's participation stayed at about half of the traces. [DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- A10 and A11 repeat in fewer traces, and A34 occurs and recurs slightly less often; these smaller shifts are less consistent. [OCC009, OCC010, OCC022]
